title: Learning Scientific Exploration from Human Research Decision Trajectories
focus_en: Extracts human research decisions from Git histories and compares inference-time demonstrations and distilled skills with supervised and reinforcement learning of next research decisions.
focus_zh: 从 Git 历史提取人类科研决策，比较推理时使用示例、提炼技能，以及通过监督学习和强化学习训练下一步科研决策的方法。
boundary_en: Git commits are incomplete proxies for research experience. The main target is similarity to recorded next decisions, not prospective evidence that a learned policy produces important discoveries.
boundary_zh: Git 提交只是科研经验的不完整代理；主要目标是与记录中下一步决策的相似度，并非前瞻性验证所学策略能够产生重要发现。

title: Structure Liberates: How Constrained Sensemaking Produces More Novel Research Output
focus_en: Constructs structured, citation-conditioned ideation trajectories and distills them into planning models through supervised fine-tuning, comparing reconstruction of known contributions with forward-looking idea generation.
focus_zh: 构建基于引用文献的结构化构思轨迹，通过监督微调将其蒸馏进研究规划模型，并比较已知贡献的路径重建与面向未来的构思生成。
boundary_en: Trajectories are synthetic reconstructions, not recorded human deliberations; judged novelty and a small computer-science execution study do not establish general scientific value. Released code covers SFT and evaluation, not the paper's exploratory RL experiments.
boundary_zh: 轨迹是合成重建，并非真实记录的人类思考过程；新颖性评分和小规模计算机科学执行实验不能确立通用科学价值。已发布代码覆盖监督微调与评价，不含论文中的探索性强化学习实验。

title: Learning to Ideate for Machine Learning Engineering Agents
focus_en: Separates strategic ideation from implementation and trains the ideator with reinforcement learning from execution-based rewards, evaluating its guidance on held-out machine-learning engineering tasks.
focus_zh: 将策略构思与代码实现分离，利用执行结果提供的奖励训练构思模型，并在未用于训练的机器学习工程任务上评价其指导作用。
boundary_en: The agent improves solutions to supplied MLE-Bench objectives; this tests transferable engineering guidance rather than choosing valuable open research questions. The reported evaluation excludes the high-complexity task subset.
boundary_zh: 智能体针对给定的 MLE-Bench 目标改进方案，检验的是可迁移的工程指导能力，而非选择有价值的开放研究问题；报告中的评价未覆盖高复杂度任务子集。

title: InternAgent-1.5: A Unified Agentic Framework for Long-Horizon Autonomous Scientific Discovery
focus_en: Connects generation, verification, and evolution through procedural strategy memory, within-trajectory experiment episodes, and semantic knowledge consolidated across sessions for long research cycles.
focus_zh: 通过程序化策略记忆、轨迹内实验片段和跨会话整合的语义知识，连接生成、验证与演化，支持长周期研究中的经验复用。
boundary_en: Its memory mechanisms mix within-run adaptation and reuse of earlier workflows. Task and case-study results do not isolate general cross-domain strategy transfer or demonstrate that the foundation model learns research taste through weight updates.
boundary_zh: 其记忆机制同时包含单次运行内适应与既往工作流复用；任务和案例结果未单独确立通用跨领域策略迁移，也未证明基础模型通过参数更新学会科研品味。

title: AutoResearchClaw: Self-Reinforcing Autonomous Research with Human-AI Collaboration
focus_en: Extracts structured lessons from failed research runs into a persistent, time-decayed store and retrieves safeguards for later runs, alongside a research pipeline with configurable human involvement.
focus_zh: 把失败研究过程提炼为结构化经验，存入带时间衰减的持久记忆，并在后续运行中检索防错规则；同时提供可配置人类参与程度的科研流程。
boundary_en: Cross-run adaptation is external lesson reuse rather than model training. Its ablation mainly supports avoiding known failure modes; the paper does not establish a higher scientific-quality ceiling or learned judgment of research importance.
boundary_zh: 跨运行适应依靠外部经验复用，而非模型训练；消融实验主要支持减少已知失败模式，并未确立科学质量上限的提高或对研究重要性的学习。

title: Bilevel Autoresearch: Meta-Autoresearching Itself
focus_en: Uses an outer loop to analyze search traces, adjust search strategy, and generate Python mechanisms that change how an inner autoresearch loop proposes and evaluates training configurations.
focus_zh: 用外层循环分析搜索轨迹、调整搜索策略并生成 Python 机制，改变内层 autoresearch 循环提出和评价训练配置的方式。
boundary_en: Evidence is limited to a small repeated study of one GPT-pretraining task. The adaptation changes search code, not the agent model's weights, and does not demonstrate cross-task transfer or unbounded recursive self-improvement.
boundary_zh: 证据限于单个 GPT 预训练任务上的少量重复实验；适应发生在搜索代码中，而非智能体模型参数中，尚未展示跨任务迁移或无限递归自我改进。

title: Learning to Discover at Test Time
focus_en: Updates language-model weights with reinforcement learning during search on a single problem, using continuous rewards to seek a high-quality solution in mathematics, kernels, algorithms, or biological data analysis.
focus_zh: 在单个问题的搜索过程中通过强化学习更新语言模型参数，利用连续奖励寻找高质量解，并在数学、算子、算法及生物数据分析中进行实验。
boundary_en: This is task-specific test-time training with a supplied objective and evaluator. It does not by itself establish retained improvement across new research tasks or the ability to select scientifically important questions.
boundary_zh: 这是依赖给定目标和评价器的单任务测试时训练；它本身不能确立在新研究任务中保留的能力提升，也不能证明选择科学上重要问题的能力。

title: OR-Agent: Bridging Evolutionary Search and Structured Research for Automated Heuristic Design
focus_en: Combines tree-based heuristic search and backtracking with experiment reflections, outcome summaries, and accumulated lessons that guide subsequent branches within an optimization run.
focus_zh: 将树形启发式搜索与回溯结合，通过实验反思、结果总结和累积经验，在同一优化过程中指导后续搜索分支。
boundary_en: Evaluations concern specified combinatorial and simulation optimization tasks. Its verbal gradients and momentum are reflection analogies, not model-weight updates or evidence of learned research strategy transfer across tasks.
boundary_zh: 评价针对给定的组合优化与仿真优化任务；文中的语言梯度和动量是对反思机制的类比，并非模型参数更新，也不构成所学科研策略跨任务迁移的证据。

title: Evolution Fine-Tuning: Learning to Discover Across 371 Optimization Tasks
focus_en: Turns evolutionary search trajectories from multiple optimization domains into supervised training data for Finch models, testing whether solution-improvement strategies transfer to held-out tasks and complement test-time reinforcement learning.
focus_zh: 把多个优化领域的进化搜索轨迹转化为 Finch 模型的监督训练数据，检验方案改进策略能否迁移到未见任务，并与测试时强化学习结合。
boundary_en: This provides cross-task training evidence under supplied objectives and evaluators, not learned question importance. Trajectory collection and primary search evaluation use one scaffold, leaving general transfer across research workflows unestablished.
boundary_zh: 这是给定目标和评价器条件下的跨任务训练证据，而非对问题重要性的学习；轨迹收集与主要搜索评价使用同一种搜索框架，尚未确立跨科研工作流的通用迁移。
